continuation_context.what_phase_5_needs_from_this_dispatch: The Zorn poset should be built over Context (G,Gamma) with Gamma:Set (LabelledFormula Atom) -- already set up for arbitrary unions, unlike NIK's List-typed judgement. Deriv 𝒯 G Gamma phi is the '|-_G' relation to use for the maximality constraint 'Gamma' cannot derive x:A' (i.e. not (Deriv T G' Gamma' (x,A))). Deriv.mono (monotonicity under Context.le) is already proved and should be reused directly for the chain-closure argument. GeomWitnessClosure is vacuously True (@[simp] geomWitnessClosure_holds discharges it trivially at every step of the chain union, including the maximal element) so clause 3 of Context needs no work in the Zorn argument -- do not be alarmed that Phase 4 did not build up nontrivial machinery for it; there is genuinely nothing to prove given Phase 1's elided k-ary witness operators. TPrime's four numbered clauses are exactly what needs to be established at the maximal element (clause 0, ClassicalModel TS5 G.R, follows the report's :6010-6040 R_chi-application argument via TClosure from Deduction.lean).
flagged_definitional_choices_for_downstr: CONTEXT.GAMMA AS SET, NOT LIST (impacts Phase 5 directly, enables it): this is the one choice in Phase 4 not dictated verbatim by the plan's checklist. NIK (Deduction.lean, Phase 2) necessarily keeps Gamma as List (derivations are finite). Context.Gamma is Set so Phase 5's Zorn chains can union to an infinite context. Bridged via the new Deriv relation (Context.lean): 'Deriv T G Gamma phi := exists finite Gamma0 subset-of Gamma, NIK T G Gamma0 phi'. All of TPrime's clauses that mention derivability use Deriv, not NIK directly. If a downstream phase finds this bridge awkward, the alternative (representing Context.Gamma some other way, e.g. as a directed union of Lists) would need re-deriving Deriv's monotonicity and the TPrime clauses from scratch -- not recommended given Deriv.mono is already proved and battle-tested against NIK.weaken.

GEOMWITNESSCLOSURE AS VACUOUS TRUE (impacts nothing downstream negatively, but is worth knowing): Context clause 3 (the k-ary geometric-witness closure condition) is defined as literally 'True' because Label (Phase 1) has no k-ary witness constructor -- only the unary dwitness. This is a faithful transcription of Simpson's clause 3 becoming vacuous under the elision Phase 1 already made and flagged, not a new corner cut in Phase 4. If a future task extends Label with k-ary witness constructors (e.g. to add chi_D/seriality to the target theory), GeomWitnessClosure is the exact, isolated place to strengthen -- nothing else in Context or TPrime needs to change.

CONTEXT DEPENDS ON A GEOMETRIC THEORY PARAMETER 𝒯 EVEN THOUGH ONLY CLAUSE 3 USES IT: Context (not just TPrime) is parameterized by 𝒯, matching Simpson's own definition (context clause 3 quantifies over 𝒯's basic geometric sequents). This means Phase 5's Zorn poset type will also carry a 𝒯 parameter; instantiate at TS5 throughout, per the plan's Non-Goals.
